title: Container Bookings: when a verified gross mass counts as late
content:
## Rule
Under the Container Bookings product line, the verified gross mass is late when the receipt moment recorded on the booking is later than the booking's VGM cut-off; received on time, it books nothing.

## Boundary cases (hypothetical times)
*Hypothetical VGM cut-off of 08:00 on 14 July, for illustration only:*
| VGM receipt moment recorded on the booking | Result |
|---|---|
| 07:59 on 14 July | on time; nothing is booked |
| 08:00 on 14 July | not later than the cut-off; on time |
| 08:01 on 14 July | late |

## Points of judgement
**Which moment decides?** The receipt moment recorded on the booking, compared with the VGM cut-off recorded on the same booking.
